title: AgentResponseReceipt
description: Audit-grade record of a single agent response. Designed so a retail risk committee can reconstruct exactly what data the agent saw, what context the model received, what confidence applied, and which fallback path triggered. One receipt per agent response. Immutable once written.

receipt_id.description: UUID v4. Primary key in the audit log.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO 8601 when the agent response was emitted.

user.description: Identity that issued the query. In production, this is an SSO subject; here it is an email.

security.description: Input-side prompt-injection scan, run before retrieval and before the model. A detected attempt sets fallback.path to blocked_injection and the model is never called.

matched_patterns.description: Names of the injection patterns that fired.

answerability.description: Whether the question maps to the agent's data domain at all. in_domain false routes to a human via fallback.path abstain_out_of_domain, recording the true reason rather than letting a low confidence score abstain for the wrong reason.

matched_ood_terms.description: Out-of-domain terms detected, e.g. geographies the dataset does not hold.

matched_anchors.description: In-domain entity terms detected in the question.

provider.description: stub indicates the agent ran without a real NIM key. Receipts from stub responses are explicitly non-production.

sources_queried.description: Every data source the retrieval layer touched, even if zero rows came back. Zero-match sources are still recorded so an auditor can verify nothing was hidden.

filter.description: Human-readable filter applied. In production, replace with a structured predicate.

row_ids.description: Stable row identifiers. Lets auditors pull the exact rows months later.

newest_row_age_days.description: Age of the freshest row matched. Feeds the recency component of confidence.

preview.description: First 800 characters of the context block sent to the model.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the full context block. Lets an auditor verify the prompt was not altered after the fact.

confidence.description: Deterministic confidence computed from data coverage, recency, and volume. NOT model self-reported.

confidence_components.description: Breakdown of how the confidence number was computed. Every term is reproducible from the receipt alone. confidence = coverage_subscore * specificity_multiplier.

data_coverage.description: Fraction of expected sources that were successfully queried (whether or not each returned rows). A clean empty result is not penalized here; the row-count signal is captured by the volume term. In production this would only drop when a source query times out or the system is unreachable.

recency.description: 1.0 if all matched rows within 14 days, decays linearly to 0.0 at 90 days.

query_specificity.description: Fraction of expected query signals (region, intent) the parser extracted. 0.0 means the question was vague enough to fall back to no filter.

coverage_subscore.description: Weighted sum of data_coverage, recency, and volume.

specificity_multiplier.description: Floor + (1 - floor) * query_specificity. Floor is 0.3, so a wholly vague question caps confidence at 30 percent of coverage_subscore.

path.description: answer_with_caveat: returned an answer but flagged uncertainty inline. abstain_route_to_human: low confidence, declined and surfaced a queue ticket. abstain_out_of_domain: question outside the data domain, routed to human. blocked_injection: prompt-injection detected in input, model never called.

review_flag.description: Grey-zone compliance signal. Triggers when fallback was answer_with_caveat AND confidence sits within review_margin of the abstain threshold. The rule worked, but barely. Compliance teams use this signal to identify rules and thresholds that need refinement.

margin.description: Width of the grey zone above the abstain threshold.

distance_to_abstain.description: confidence - abstain. Triggered when this is non-negative and below margin.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock time from query received to receipt emitted.

answer_summary.description: First 400 chars of the answer the agent returned. Full answer is in the audit log entry, not the receipt itself.
